structure.unit: Forest Resources and the Department of Forestry
Forest Management of State-Owned Lands Fund

law.catch_line: Use of Fund; management, receipt and expenditure of moneys
law.text: The Fund shall be used to defray the costs of timber sales, to develop forest management plans for state-owned lands pursuant to § 10.1-1124, and to implement those plans. The Department shall have the authority to manage, receive and expend moneys for and from the Fund for these purposes.
